notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

viewer.description: Verified locally from Kutup's encrypted cache. Closing removes the temporary view.
viewer.openFailed: This attachment could not be opened safely.

attachments.tooLarge: That file is larger than this server’s {{limit}} limit.
attachments.downloadFailed: The encrypted attachment could not be downloaded.
attachments.saveFailed: The attachment could not be saved to this device.
attachments.clearFailed: The local copy could not be cleared.

voice.unsupported: Voice recording is not supported by this browser.
voice.maximumReached: Maximum voice-note duration reached; sending the recording.
voice.permissionFailed: Microphone access was denied or could not be started.
voice.tooLarge: Voice note exceeds the {{limit}} recording limit.
voice.playFailed: The voice message could not be played.

safety.title: Verify {{peer}}
safety.description: Meet in person and scan the QR code shown on the other person's device. Both devices must show the same complete safety number.
safety.stateBlocked: The pinned identity changed or contradicted its history. Sending remains blocked until you verify this exact replacement.
safety.stateVerified: Verified face to face on this device.
safety.stateUnverified: Encrypted with a valid pinned identity, but not verified face to face.
safety.verifiedToast: {{peer}} is now verified on this device
safety.mismatch: That QR code does not match this conversation. Nothing was verified.
safety.scanUnsupported: This browser cannot scan QR codes. Paste the QR value instead.
safety.cameraUnavailable: Camera access was unavailable. Paste the QR value instead.
safety.verifiedStatus: You have verified this safety number.
safety.changedStatus: The safety number changed. Verify it again before sharing anything sensitive.
safety.unverifiedStatus: Compare the safety number with {{name}} in person or on a call to be sure no one is in between.

groupSecurity.authorityExplainer: Live policy histories are independently authenticated by this client. The group keeps its exact pinned control key until an owner-approved MLS transition.
groupSecurity.differsFromPin: Authenticated current policy differs from group pin
groupSecurity.unavailableExplainer: Current authenticated policy evidence is unavailable. The exact group pin above remains in force; there is no key replacement or fallback.

chat.noteToSelfDescription: Private notes synced to your linked devices
chat.empty: Start an encrypted conversation or save a private note.
chat.safetyNumberChanged: A recipient device identity changed. Verify the safety number.

backup.title: Encrypted Chat history
backup.recovery: Restores automatically with the same recovery phrase as Drive.
backup.waiting: Waiting for the first server acknowledgement
backup.pending: {{count}} message changes ({{bytes}}) are still stored only on this device.
backup.full: Chat storage is full. Delete messages or media, or ask your server admin to increase the quota. New local changes are not protected until storage is available and the server acknowledges them.
backup.attention: Chat history protection needs attention. Kutup will keep retrying; local changes are not protected until the server acknowledges them.
backup.storageDescription: Chat history and media use a dedicated server-administered quota; Drive is separate. Delivery copies expire after {{days}} days, while protected history copies remain.
backup.storageDescriptionUnlimited: Chat history and media use a dedicated server-administered quota; Drive is separate. Delivery-copy expiry is disabled, while protected history copies remain independently retained.

contact.title: Your chat address
contact.description: Share this stable username@server address or let someone scan its QR code.
contact.qr: QR code of your chat address

deviceRecovery.title: Reset this browser’s Chat device?
deviceRecovery.description: Kutup will remove this browser’s invalid cryptographic device state, register a fresh device, and restore server-acknowledged encrypted history. Your account and server backup are not deleted.
deviceRecovery.warning: Chat changes that exist only in this browser and were never acknowledged by the server may be lost. Close other Kutup tabs before continuing.
deviceRecovery.failed: This browser’s Chat device could not be reset.

devices.title: Active Chat installations
devices.description: Each browser profile, private window, or cleared site storage is a separate end-to-end encrypted installation. Names are private to your account and do not change encryption keys.
devices.name: Device name
devices.confirm: Revoke {{device}}? It will stop receiving future messages.
devices.historyWarning: Revocation stops future delivery. It does not copy that device's local message history.

disappearing.explanation: New messages here disappear from every device after the time you choose, for everyone in the chat.

errors.browserUnsupported: This browser cannot safely coordinate encrypted chat across tabs.
errors.serverUnsupported: This server does not support the required secure chat protocol.
errors.capabilities: Kutup could not check whether this server supports secure chat.
errors.invalidAddress: Enter a valid username or username@server address.
errors.groupSend: The message could not be sent to the group. Try again.

mutations.deleteChoice: Delete it from your devices only, or for everyone in this chat.
mutations.deleteForMeOnly: It will be deleted from all your devices. The others in this chat keep their copies.

profile.title: Chat profile
profile.description: Your name and avatar are encrypted before they leave this device.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP. The image is cropped and resized on this device.
profile.visibility: Like Signal, Kutup shares this profile only with people you message or accept. Blocking someone rotates your profile key so they cannot fetch future changes.
profile.avatarError: That image could not be used as a profile photo.

receipts.settingDescription: When this is on, people you chat with can see when you have read their messages. Delivery receipts in direct chats are always sent, encrypted.

requests.description: Accept to reply, reject to remove these messages, or block future messages.
requests.blocked: {{peer}} is blocked. New messages are securely discarded on this device.

chat.encryptedIntro: Messages and files here are end-to-end encrypted: only the people in a conversation can read them.

newChat.title: New chat
newChat.description: Enter a username on {{server}}, or username@server for someone on another server.

list.label: Conversations
list.pinLimit: You can pin up to {{count}} chats.
list.deleteDescription: Its messages will be deleted from all your devices. The other people in it keep their copies.

thread.empty: No messages yet. Messages you send are end-to-end encrypted.
thread.notFound: This conversation address is not valid.

composer.label: Message
composer.tooLong: This is longer than the group allows. Shorten it to send.

message.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it instead.

readOnly.history: Only the history of this group is left on this device. It is read-only.
readOnly.closed: This group was closed. Its history stays, but nothing new can be sent.
readOnly.adminsOnly: Only administrators can send messages in this group.
readOnly.pendingInvitations_one: Waiting for {{count}} invited member to accept before messages can be sent.
readOnly.pendingInvitations_other: Waiting for {{count}} invited members to accept before messages can be sent.

group.rolesExplanation: Administrators add and remove members. Owners approve changes to the group’s rules together.
group.newDescription: Start a private, end-to-end encrypted group with one person; add more from its details.
group.addMemberDescription: They get an encrypted invitation to accept.
group.approvalRequested: Sent to the other owners for approval

feedback.rejected: Rejected the invitation — remove them to send again
feedback.expired: The invitation expired — remove them to send again

group.recoverDescription: Use this only when the group’s ordering servers cannot make progress. The group moves to a fresh start with the same members and owners; the other owners may need to approve.
group.closeDescription: Closing is permanent: its history stays, but no one can send or change anything. The other owners may need to approve.
group.closedNotice: This group is closed. Its history stays, but no new messages or changes are possible.

close.title: Approve closing this group?
close.description: {{requester}} proposes closing the group for good.

recovery.title: Approve recovering this group?
recovery.description: {{requester}} proposes moving the group to a fresh start with the same members and owners.

cryptography.title: Approve a smaller message limit?
cryptography.description: {{requester}} proposes messages of at most {{detail}} bytes.

group.whoEdits: Who can edit this group's name, picture and description

info.description: Only the members of this group can see its name, picture and description.
info.name: Group name
info.pictureUnreadable: That picture can't be used. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

leave.title: Leave this group?
leave.description: You will no longer be able to send or receive messages in this group. Its history stays on your devices until you delete the chat.
leave.chooseAdmin: You are the only administrator. Choose who becomes an administrator when you leave:
leave.owner: You are an owner of this group. Make another member an owner first; then you can leave.
leave.onlyMember: You are the only member. Close the group instead.

storage.clearDescription: The messages stay, but files not saved elsewhere may no longer open.

connection.queued: New messages will appear once you're connected. Messages you send will go out then.

groupUpdates.nameChanged_you: You changed the group name to “{{name}}”.
